choices.label: Morphs through classic synth waveforms, adds overtones or changes the pulse width.
A pseudo-random lo-fi square wave oscillator reminiscent of loading an old computer game from a tape.
A synthesized bubble generator.
A chiptune oscillator which provides pitch, pulse width and interval.
A synthesized crackle generator.
Morphs through classic synth waveforms, adds overtones or changes the pulse width.
An oscillator that retriggers a kick drum oscillator at fast rates to produce granular-esque tonal sounds.
A noise generator with a resonant band-pass filter.
A harmonic FM oscillator with modulation amounts and wave folding.
A harmonic FM oscillator with modulation ratio and amount.
An oscillator that loops a noise buffer at fast rates to produce granular-esque tonal sounds.
Morphs through classic synth waveforms and defines the amount of noise injection.
A rain generator with synthesized drops and wind.
A Shepard tone oscillator with depth and direction.
A simple FM oscillator with modulation index and amount.
Morphs a square to a square pitched a fifth above with pulse width adjustment.
Two synced square waves where the frequency of each can be defined.
A FM oscillator with modulation index amount and operator feedback.
A sub oscillator with waveform morphing and an additional sub (aux).
A swarm of saw waves with modulation and frequency spacing.
A swarm of sine waves with modulation and frequency spacing.
A swarm of square waves with modulation and frequency spacing.
A swarm of triangle waves with modulation and frequency spacing.
An impulse/drum oscillator with decay and tone controls.
